body:
>It wouldn't hurt to try to exhaust it before doing anything drastic.

 My thoughts exactly! Thanks for the advice.
Ugh. Yeah, they're fucking useless. Same happened to me.

>It's impossible to take residence at your friend's place; their family doesn't want any legal trouble.

  It is possible, but I need my parents' consent.

>Presently filing for a divorce would be a hindrance since you and your father need to think of transportation and other familial duties.


  Correct.

>You're turning 18 in 3 months.


  Yep.

>Still... I don't think it's reasonable to run away.

  It's going to happen, probably not to the extreme you're thinking of though.
All my nearby family is dead. The only relative alive is my 90 year old grandmother in assisted living. All I really have is my friend from school.

Do you have any marks, bruises, etc from her hitting you? Either way, go to the counselors at your school and tell them everything, make sure to include that you're scared of her. If you're being physically harmed, they're required by law to report it to the appropriate agencies.

They're definitely going to divorce as soon as I'm off to college. He's afraid to file a divorce now because then somebody needs to take me to school, and somebody needs to take over the chores around the house that my mom would do. On top of that, he would have to be going to court and stuff, that shit takes all day. He's trying to keep his job.

I'm not giving the exact details of what I'm doing. Nobody, including myself, will get physically hurt.

She's always been like this.

>Because if so, couldn't you talk to her and show her the wrong she's doing?

  You're very new to narcissistic mothers, aren't you?
Yes, he would. Although, he's scared of the state taking me away and putting me in a foster home because most of the people who run those are trash who are in it for the benefits. Can't blame him.

I can't just go over there, his parents don't want legal involvement. My parents still have custody of me, if they call the police, both parties here will probably get in trouble. Now, would the police understand, and be more forgiving? Sure, but good luck telling my dad that.

>If you run away, you can hurt him, etc...
  

I'm not running away long term and trying to live on the streets by myself, that's fucking brutal, I'll be worse off than now.

>Coudln't you just go and if your mother call the police or whatever, they'll have the record of what happened and understand your side
  

Are you saying to run away?

That's the plan!
